breakpoints.note: Within the truncated 32767-byte prefix, `has_crlfcrlf()` finds `\r\n\r\n` at offsets 32762..32765, so the finalizer accepts the witness and `fuzz_parse_http_request()` proceeds to `parse_http_request()`. The same copied prefix also contains `HTTP/1.0\r` at offset 32756, letting request-line parsing reach `parse_headers()`.

First project-side consumption of the attacker input. This clamp converts the 32768-byte witness into the truncated logical request length `32767` that all later parser bounds derive from, so the copied request ends on a lone trailing `\r` at offset 32766.

Incomplete blank-line guard. The branch treats any `\r` at the current scan position as an empty header line and immediately performs a two-byte lookahead, but it never checks the remaining logical span against `buffer_end`. The patch adds the missing predicate `buffer_end - next_chr > 2` at this exact line.
